_meta.notes: Dev-only settings engine. Only loaded when NODE_ENV !== 'production'.

dev_panel_enabled.notes: Master switch for dev panel. When false, panel cannot be opened even with ?dev=1

persistence_enabled.notes: When true, plants persist across disconnects within the reconnect window. When false (default), plants are session-only and removed immediately on disconnect.

reconnect_window_seconds.notes: How long a plant waits for its owner to reconnect before being removed (persistence must be enabled).

auto_growth.notes: When true, seeds can auto-germinate and plants can grow without player commits. When false (default), all growth requires player action.

germination_gate.notes: When true, germination requires moisture and light thresholds. When false, germination always succeeds.

germination_failure_kills_seed.notes: When true, failing germination destroys the seed/plant. When false, it just pauses growth.

seed_size_class.notes: Scales the initial plant model and camera framing. Normal = standard, Large = 2x, Giant = 4x.

camera_start_distance.notes: Initial camera distance from plant root on spawn.

camera_recenter_distance.notes: Camera distance when Space is pressed to recenter on plant.

camera_pan_speed.notes: Camera pan speed in units per second for WASD/arrow keys.

webgpu_enabled.notes: Enable WebGPU render path when available

webgpu_tier0_threshold.notes: Projected pixel size for tier 0 (full mesh)

webgpu_tier1_threshold.notes: Projected pixel size for tier 1 (mid mesh)

webgpu_tier3_threshold.notes: Projected pixel size for tier 3 (billboard); below uses tier 4
